text_block_list.text:
With a fantastic performance in the
Twinkle
Series, Сайленс Судзука has had
an impressive first
three years.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
An important milestone is now behind
us. But one
peaceful day...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: (Spe looks so serious, hehe.)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука has come to see Special
Week
race in a scrimmage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You have a scrimmage tomorrow?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Yup. And get this, both El and Grass are
racing
too.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to tell you, but
only if I
can beat those two.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
(I wonder what it could be after all this
time...)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Well, if it isn't Suzuka. We don't see you
here
spectating very often.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Oh hello, Эйр Грув. Spe invited me,
so... here I
am.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: What about you?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I've given instruction to a number of
those
participating today, so I've come
to see the fruits
of my labor.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув's eyes soften as she looks
across at
the Umamusume lined up in the
starting gates.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That reminds me, it seems like you've
gotten
yourself quite the following
recently.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Do you think so?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I'd be lying if I said I wasn't a little
jealous, but... I
understand why.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Running like the wind across the turf,
then gaining
even more speed down the
final stretch... It's not
something you see
every day.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I mentioned before about you being a
guiding
light for the younger students,
but...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, you were a guiding light
for me
too.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Ka-chak!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The sound of the starting gates opening
cuts
through the air.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume dash out onto the track
all at
once.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I do hope you take what I've told you to
heart.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Yeah, I will.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Even if it is just a scrimmage, a race is a
race.
Everyone gives it everything they
have.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик is situated toward the
back,
observing the spread of runners
before her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Spe...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
The race continues without a clear
leader—then
Спешл Уик begins
closing in on the fourth
corner.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Raaaah!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Her fighting spirit surges along with her
speed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She charges past the other racers, one
by one.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh, those three are neck and neck!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I won't let you win!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Graaaah!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер, Эль Кондор Паса, and,
finally,
Спешл Уик...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The three racers throw themselves
towards the
finish line with all their
might!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Suzukaaaa!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Spe! Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Thank you! So, um, about that thing I
wanted to
tell you...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: I'm going to surpass you!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
She repeatedly blinks as Спешл Уик
makes her
sudden declaration. Air
Groove bursts into
laughter.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Спешл Уик, if you're trying to
make a
statement, make it properly.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Sorry!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Um, so... do you remember the night of
the
Mainichi Okan?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
That was the night when Спешл Уик's
desire to
catch up with Сайленс Судзука
became a desire to
overtake her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I've been working so hard ever since
then.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
But for some reason, I just couldn't work
up the
confidence to tell you.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Somewhere in my heart, I was doubting
that I
could really do it.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
You know, I've always thought both El
and Grass
were amazing runners.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
But I can't just sit back always thinking
about how
amazing everyone is.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
And that goes double if I want to be
better than
you, Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
That seems to be what fueled the
impressive
performance we witnessed in
the scrimmage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's what you wanted to tell
me.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I was finally able to compete with El and
Grass.
That's why, now, I can say this
confidently.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I will surpass you, Suzuka! Just wait until
we meet
on the track!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: All right... You're on!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It looks like you've got yourself a new
rival,
Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
It seems so. I guess there are still more
challenges
coming my way.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Spe. But all the same, I have
no plans
to give up the lead.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I understand, but I'm coming for it!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Later, at night...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's off in her own world, so I try to get
her
attention.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh... Hello, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing. I just... felt like looking
out at
the grounds.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Spe told me today that she wants to be
my rival.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yeah. I'm really happy about it. It
feels like
the beginning of something
new.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
And I'm sure there's something new
waiting after I
compete with her too.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Her eyes glitter with anticipation as she
stares out
across the dark field.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So many things have happened since I
came here.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It's been about three years since I met
Silence
Suzuka... I can't say that every
day went the way I
expected it to.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I know I'm not always going to achieve
success in
the future.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I may find myself lost every now and
again...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But as long as you're with me, I know I'll
be okay.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Just like I've been all this time.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: She smiles warmly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the challenges
ahead,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
